actual: 当前v1.5开发规范、Issue并行流程规范和客户端入口存在重复分级、过期版本引用及过多负向条款。需收敛为唯一权威开发规范，以正向执行规则描述流程，仅保留禁止简化交付、禁止静默错误、禁止改变批准设计的业务逻辑、禁止私自增加门禁和审批四类禁令，并确保全局Claude Code、全局Codex和官方隔离Codex使用一致入口；官方隔离Claude profile不在本次范围。
closure_requirements: Keep one authoritative human-readable development standard and one same-version machine-derived catalog.
Route Codex, Claude Code, and the official isolated Codex profile through the same repository workflow sources.
Keep only the four approved prohibition classes; express all other workflow rules as positive execution guidance.
Run the smallest directly relevant workflow and client verification.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: 当前v1.5开发规范、Issue并行流程规范和客户端入口存在重复分级、过期版本引用及过多负向条款。需收敛为唯一权威开发规范，以正向执行规则描述流程，仅保留禁止简化交付、禁止静默错误、禁止改变批准设计的业务逻辑、禁止私自增加门禁和审批四类禁令，并确保全局Claude Code、全局Codex和官方隔离Codex使用一致入口；官方隔离Claude profile不在本次范围。
expected: The v1.5 Markdown standard is the sole human-readable authority, its YAML file is explicitly derived, legacy workflow documents only redirect to that authority, and all in-scope clients install the same repository entrypoints.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
Do not update the official isolated Claude profile in this BUG.
